results.answer: 追加模式选择 'a'，UTF-8 写法可写为 open(filename, 'a', encoding='utf-8')；稿件说明 'a' opens the file for appending; any data written to the file is automatically added to the end. 与 'w' 的差异是：'w' for only writing (an existing file with the same name will be erased)，即只写且同名已有文件会被擦除；而 'a' 不会擦除，写入自动追加到末尾。
results.excerpt: mode can be 'r' when the file will only be read, 'w' for only writing (an existing file with the same name will be erased), and 'a' opens the file for appending; any data written to the file is automatically added to the end.
results.reason: 稿件明确给出 'a' 追加模式、'w' 会擦除已有文件，以及 UTF-8 推荐；可直接推导日志追加方案。

results.answer: 使用 with 是为了让文件对象在 suite 结束后被正确关闭，即使过程中抛出异常也会关闭；并且 with 比等价的 try-finally 块更短。
results.excerpt: It is good practice to use the with keyword when dealing with file objects.  The advantage is that the file is properly closed after its suite finishes, even if an exception is raised at some point.  Using with is also much shorter than writing equivalent try-finally blocks:
results.reason: 稿件明确说明 with 的优点是自动正确关闭文件，即使异常也关闭，并比 try-finally 更短。

results.answer: f.readline() 返回空字符串表示已经到达文件末尾；返回仅含一个换行符的字符串 '\n' 表示这一行是空行，而不是文件结束。
results.excerpt: This makes the return value unambiguous; if f.readline() returns an empty string, the end of the file has been reached, while a blank line is represented by '\n', a string containing only a single newline.
results.reason: 稿件直接区分了 readline 返回空串与返回 '\n' 的含义。

results.answer: 逐行读取大文件可直接循环文件对象，例如：for line in f: print(line, end='')。稿件说明这种读法 memory efficient, fast, and leads to simple code。与 f.read() 不带 size 的差别是：不带 size/负 size 的 read 会读取并返回整个文件内容，如果文件比内存大两倍会由用户自己承担问题；而逐行循环不会一次性读取整个文件，因此对大文件更节省内存。

results.reason: 稿件给出循环文件对象逐行读取且内存高效，并说明 f.read(size) 省略/负值时读取整个文件。

results.answer: 复制 JPEG 时必须使用二进制模式，即在模式中追加 'b'；二进制模式下读写的数据对象是 bytes 对象；并且不能在二进制模式下指定 encoding 参数。稿件指出文本模式会转换平台相关换行，这会破坏 JPEG 等二进制数据，因此读写这类文件要非常小心地使用二进制模式。
results.excerpt: Appending a 'b' to the mode opens the file in binary mode. Binary mode data is read and written as bytes objects. You can not specify encoding when opening file in binary mode.
results.reason: 稿件明确二进制模式的数据对象是 bytes，且二进制模式不能指定 encoding；另有 JPEG 例证需用二进制模式避免破坏数据。
